dedupe_keys.name: erigrid 2 0 benchmark model of an electrical network matlab simulink

description: This is the electrical network benchmark model developed in the EU Horizon 2020 ERIGrid 2.0 project on research infrastructure for smart grid and energy system testing. It was released on GitHub and Zenodo (version 1.1, November 2021) by Antonio De Paola for the project, with a last commit in February 2022. The repository contains MATLAB/Simulink implementations of two versions of the model, a dynamic one and a phasor one, a list describing each modelling file, and a description of the model following the PreCISE documentation template used in ERIGrid for benchmark models. Coverage is a benchmark system not tied to a place. The files are accessible on GitHub and Zenodo under the BSD 3-clause licence at no cost. Caveats: MATLAB and Simulink licences are needed, and the model is intended for method testing, not planning of a real grid. Simulation uses are testing controls, protection and co-simulation setups on a shared reference network, and laboratory validation experiments. Related records: data-certs-microgrid-test-bed is another test system used for validation.
